definitions.name: O3A.BSTEPS
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'BC' BIND 1 -1 BC ')' EQ NOT BC ']' EQ NOT AND SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String to a Vector of +1 for each opener and -1 for each closer

definitions.name: O3A.RSTEP
definitions.body: 'RE' BIND 'RA' BIND RA CHARS -1 DROP JOIN RA RE 2 COLLECT JOIN RA CHARS -1 GET RE 2 COLLECT JOIN 'RP' BIND RP '()' EQ NOT RP '[]' EQ NOT AND NOT SELECT
definitions.note: FOLD/SCAN step (stack-String char): pop the last char when it opens what char closes, else append char; seed with 'X'

definitions.name: O3A.REDUCE
definitions.note: bracket String to 'X' followed by what is left after deleting matched () and [] pairs

definitions.name: O3A.PSTEP
definitions.body: 'PE' BIND [ 'PS' 'PN' 'PB' ] BIND PS PE O3A.RSTEP 'PT' BIND PN 1 ADD 'PM' BIND PT PM PM PB PT 'X' EQ SELECT 3 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step over [ stack length best ] recording the longest balanced prefix length in best

definitions.name: O3A.RLESTEP
definitions.body: 'RLE' BIND 'RLA' BIND RLA -1 GET 'RLL' BIND RLA RLA LENGTH 1 SUB RLL 0 GET RLL 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT PUT RLA RLE 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 RLL 0 GET RLE EQ SELECT GET
definitions.note: FOLD step over a non-empty Vector of [ value count ] pairs: bump the last count or append [ elem 1 ]

definitions.name: O3A.RLE
definitions.body: 'RLV' BIND RLV RLV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT [ O3A.RLESTEP ] FOLD
definitions.note: non-empty Vector to its run-length encoding, a Vector of [ value count ] pairs

definitions.name: O3A.UPSTEP
definitions.body: 'UE' BIND [ 'UP' 'UC' 'UB' ] BIND UC 1 ADD 1 UE UP GT SELECT 'UN' BIND UE UN UB UN MAX 3 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step over [ previous current-run best ] for the longest strictly increasing stretch

definitions.name: O3A.FFSTEP
definitions.body: 'FE' BIND 'FA' BIND FA FE FE NIL? SELECT
definitions.note: SCAN step: the element, or the accumulator when the element is NIL (forward fill)

definitions.name: O3A.GAPSTEP
definitions.body: 'GE' BIND [ 'GP' 'GC' ] BIND GE NIL? 'GM' BIND GM GC 1 ADD GC GM GP NOT AND SELECT 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step over [ previous-missing count ] counting runs of NIL; seed FALSE 0 2 COLLECT

definitions.name: O3A.LGSTEP
definitions.body: 'LGE' BIND [ 'LGC' 'LGB' ] BIND LGC 1 ADD 0 LGE NIL? SELECT 'LGN' BIND LGN LGB LGN MAX 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step over [ current-NIL-run best ] tracking the longest run of NIL; seed 0 0 2 COLLECT

definitions.name: O3A.RATSTEP
definitions.body: 'TE' BIND [ 'TP' 'TIG' ] BIND 1 TE TE NIL? SELECT 'TX' BIND 1 TP TP NIL? SELECT 'TY' BIND NIL TX TY DIV TE NIL? NOT TP NIL? NOT AND NOT SELECT 'TQ' BIND TE TQ 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: SCAN step over [ previous ratio ]: [ elem elem/previous ], ratio NIL when either is NIL

definitions.name: O3A.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'MN' BIND MS MN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty Vector of numbers (mean of the two middle ones when even)
